title: Ampleness descends and ascends along finite surjective morphisms
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] proper over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $f:Y\to X$ be an $R$-morphism which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and surjective on underlying spaces [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. For every invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], one has that $\mathcal L$ is ample on $X$ if and only if $f^*\mathcal L$ is ample on $Y$, where pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback] and both occurrences of ample mean the absolute affine-nonvanishing-locus condition [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].
